note: The session's web search allowance ran out after the first eight candidates, so the rest were looked up only on pages whose address was already known or could be reached from one (school districts' own board pages, the House's own member list, the parties' own endorsement pages, the candidates' own sites). Not reached: David Prestin's campaign site (it answered 429, so it is left out), the Oakland County Republican slate page naming Johnnette Eggert (the page is drawn by script and its text could not be read), the Governor's press releases (the state's site refuses scripts), Lincoln Park's council page. A search summary said a Brittany Johnson was appointed to the 23rd District Court in 2021; her own campaign site says March 2026, and the 2021 page could not be opened, so only the campaign's statement is recorded. A blank here means not looked up or not found, not that nothing exists.
